files.description: The registered EHI export documentation page. A static HTML page containing ~150 words of inline text describing the CDAEXPORT module. Describes three export modes (All Patients, Select Patients, Single Patient), export format (CDA XML + HTML + PDF documents), and folder naming convention. No data dictionary, no schema, no field-level detail, no download links.
Full-page screenshot of the dataExport.html page showing the complete EHI export documentation.

ONC mandatory cost transparency disclosures. 2-page PDF listing fees for various certified capabilities (e-prescribing, patient portal, lab interfaces, API access). Does not mention the (b)(10) data export module or associated costs. Linked from the MIPS solutions page alongside the dataExport.html link.
